name: Outlaw
attacks: Revolver +3 (1d8+1 piercing, 20/60, 6 rds, MF 1), Bowie +3 (1d6+1 piercing)

attackList.name: Revolver
attackList.notes: Pony Arms ChaosMaker, Medium (.44-40). Close quarters: no disadvantage with a hostile within 5 ft. Misfire on a natural 1: miss, jam, and the round is still spent. Reload is an action; Tactical Reload loads 1 round as a bonus action.

attackList.name: Bowie
attackList.notes: Martial. Finesse, light.

traits.name: Cover Habit (tactic)
traits.text: Shoots, then uses Take Cover (bonus action) behind solid cover such as a wagon, embankment, or switch stand. Ranged attacks against it have disadvantage until its next attack, and firing ends it. It won't charge into melee unless a PC closes.

traits.name: Morale (tactic)
traits.text: If the leader runs or drops, or two of the gang are down, the last outlaws surrender, or flee if they have a horse and room to run.

tactics: Surrenders when wounded or outnumbered; lookouts ride off to warn the gang.
tacticsSource: IDEAS Ch2 robber/lookouts + playtest Morale trait
loot: Pockets: roll d6 on the outlaw drop table (IDEAS draft, average 250 ES). A gun taken off the dead is Dirty. Keepable gun (one per encounter): the ChaosMaker Medium he fired (2,500 ES list; gear, not cash).
lootSource: playtest bestiary.json (drop table §1.1) + DND Bot lock pass S23 gun
description: Basic gunman: trail outlaw with a six-gun and a Bowie (Gunslinger Outlaw block).

name: Switch Boss
attacks: Dirty Rifle +3 (1d8+1 piercing, 30/120, 6 rds, MF 1-2), Bowie +3 (1d6+1 piercing)

attackList.name: Dirty Rifle
attackList.notes: Henrietta Repeating Rifle, Medium (.44-40), Dirty. Martial. Two-handed. No close quarters: disadvantage with a hostile within 5 ft. Misfire on a natural 1-2: miss, jam, and the round is still spent. Reload is an action; Tactical Reload loads 1 round as a bonus action.

attackList.name: Bowie
attackList.notes: Martial. Finesse, light. Only if a PC closes on the handcar.

traits.name: Dirty Rifle
traits.text: The rifle is Dirty: it misfires on at least 1–2 until someone cleans it (10 minutes with gunsmith's tools or a gun cleaning kit). A misfire misses and jams the rifle, and the round is still spent. It fouls (unusable until a short rest with tools, or 500 ES to a gunsmith) if both d20s show 1–2 on a roll with advantage or disadvantage, or if it gets dirty again.

traits.name: Handcar Nest (tactic)
traits.text: Stays on the handcar and fires the rifle, then uses Take Cover (bonus action) behind the handcar. Ranged attacks against him have disadvantage until his next attack, and firing ends it.

traits.name: Morale (tactic)
traits.text: When he is the last of the crew standing, he flees on the handcar. If he runs, the remaining outlaws surrender.

actions.name: Clear Jam
actions.text: Clears the jammed rifle with his action, or with a bonus action and a DC 10 Dexterity check (+1; no tool proficiency). A fouled rifle can't be cleared in the fight.

actions.name: Flee on the Handcar
actions.text: Morale break: he takes the handcar down the line and leaves the fight.

tactics: Flees on the handcar when he is the last of the crew standing.
tacticsSource: INTRO-FIGHTS Night at the Switch / live DMCC switch-boss
loot: Boss poke: 2 Yellow + 1 Green (250 ES). His rifle: Dirty Henrietta Repeating Rifle (.44-40) and leftover tube rounds, gear at PHB list (6,500 ES), not cash. Scene finds, not on him: tool box (Investigation DC 12) with a crowbar and a gun cleaning kit (100 ES gear); handcar lockbox (thieves' tools DC 12 or Str DC 15) with 1 Purple (500 ES) under 1 Black decoy.
lootSource: live DMCC switch-boss (INTRO-FIGHTS Night at the Switch)
description: Rifleman who runs the rail-switch crew in Night at the Switch; fires a Dirty Henrietta from the handcar.

name: Buffalo Bull

traits.name: Charge
traits.text: If the buffalo bull moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a tusk attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 7 (2d6) slashing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

traits.name: Relentless
traits.text: If the buffalo bull takes 10 damage or less that would reduce it to 0 hit points, it is reduced to 1 hit point instead.

tactics: Charges the nearest rider or horse from 20 ft out, then gores; Relentless keeps it standing once, and it breaks off when the herd runs.
loot: No cash. Hide, horns and meat, 1,000 ES (takes a horse to haul): 1 hour and Survival DC 12 to harvest; on a fail the part is ruined and worth a quarter.
description: Shaggy plains buffalo bull: a wall of horn and muscle, or the lead animal in a stampede.

name: Buffalo Spirit
languages: understands Common and Trail Tongue but can’t speak

attackList.name: Hooves
attackList.notes: One prone creature only.

traits.name: Charge
traits.text: If the buffalo spirit moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a ram attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 7 (2d6) damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

tactics: Charges whoever wronged the herd or the grass and tramples anyone it knocks prone; it fades when the wrong is set right or it drops below half HP (21).
loot: None. Spirits fade and leave nothing.
description: Spectral plains buffalo-elk, omen of big weather or a wrong done to the grass.
pendingJessey: J5: creature type kept as beast

name: Cactus Witch

attackList.name: Claws
attackList.notes: Melee weapon attack, one target.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.text: She can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.text: Charisma (spell save DC 12), no material components. At will: dancing lights, minor illusion, vicious mockery.

traits.name: Mimicry
traits.text: She can mimic animal sounds and humanoid voices. A creature that hears them can tell they are imitations with a DC 14 Wisdom (Insight) check.

actions.name: Illusory Appearance
actions.text: She covers herself and her gear with an illusion of another creature of her size and humanoid shape. It ends if she ends it as a bonus action or dies. It fails physical inspection (touch feels her rough flesh); otherwise a creature must use an action and pass a DC 20 Intelligence (Investigation) check to see through it.

actions.name: Invisible Passage
actions.text: She turns invisible (Invisible) until she attacks or casts a spell, or until her concentration ends, as if concentrating on a spell. She leaves no physical trail, so only magic can track her. Her gear is invisible with her.

spells.name: Vicious Mockery
spells.summary: One creature that can hear her makes a WIS save; on a failure it takes 1d4 psychic and has disadvantage on its next attack roll before the end of its next turn.

rider.text: On a failed save the target has disadvantage on its next attack roll before the end of its next turn. This is not a condition, so no condition badge.

spells.name: Minor Illusion
spells.summary: A sound or a still image up to a 5-ft cube for 1 minute; a creature that spends an action studying it sees through it on a DC 12 Investigation check.

spells.name: Dancing Lights
spells.summary: Up to four torch-bright lights (or one glowing humanoid shape) she can move 60 ft as a bonus action; concentration, up to 1 minute.

tactics: Opens in a friendly disguise, goes invisible to reach the weakest traveler, and strikes with advantage (the attack ends it). At half HP (41) she turns invisible again and slips away; Invisible Passage leaves no trail.
loot: Nothing in her pockets. Her nest pays: d6 on the Cactus Witch nest table (IDEAS draft, average about 715 ES), plus a half-used herbalism kit (500 ES list). Any shards she pays a PC are Black.
description: Desert crone fey who wears borrowed faces and voices, with innate cantrips and claws (Green Hag clone).

name: Claim Rust Bug

traits.name: Iron Scent
traits.text: The claim rust bug can pinpoint, by scent, the location of ferrous metal within 30 feet of it.

traits.name: Rust Metal
traits.text: Any nonmagical weapon made of metal that hits the claim rust bug corrodes. After dealing damage, the weapon takes a permanent and cumulative −1 penalty to damage rolls. If its penalty drops to −5, the weapon is destroyed. Nonmagical ammunition made of metal that hits the claim rust bug is destroyed after dealing damage. Ordinary guns, blades, bullets, and shot are nonmagical. A Story Find weapon, Charged Cartridges, or a gun under Magic Weapon (Rifling) is magical and doesn’t corrode.

actions.name: Antennae
actions.text: The claim rust bug corrodes a nonmagical ferrous metal object it can see within 5 feet of it. If the object isn’t being worn or carried, the touch destroys a 1-foot cube of it. If the object is being worn or carried by a creature, the creature can make a DC 11 Dexterity saving throw to avoid the claim rust bug’s touch. If the object touched is either metal armor or a metal shield being worn or carried, it takes a permanent and cumulative −1 penalty to the AC it offers. Armor reduced to an AC of 10 or a shield that drops to a +0 bonus is destroyed. If the object touched is a held metal weapon, it rusts as described in the Rust Metal trait.

tactics: Smells out the best gun or iron in reach and goes for the metal, not the person; winks out when the Dark Gift ends.
loot: None. It winks out with the Dark Gift; whatever it rusted stays rusted.
description: Calf-sized bug from a Dark Gift that rusts six-guns and shovel heads.
pendingJessey: J6: plain cartridges treated as nonmagical, whatever gun fires them

name: Dust Devil

attackList.name: Bite
attackList.notes: Uses DEX (+2), as in the canon block. Advantage from Pack Tactics when an ally is within 5 ft of the target.

rider.text: If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 11 Strength save or be knocked Prone.

traits.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
traits.text: Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.text: Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of its allies is within 5 ft of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

tactics: Pack rushes the first creature in the doorway; when one wolf drops, the rest make a DC 10 Wisdom save or flee. Fire keeps them at bay.
loot: No cash. Pelt + varmint bounty, 150 ES (IDEAS draft): 1 hour and Survival DC 12 to harvest; on a fail the part is ruined and worth a quarter.
description: Dust-colored prairie wolf that hunts in packs and drags riders down (Wolf clone).

name: Giant Crocodile

attackList.name: Bite
attackList.notes: On a hit: The target is grappled (escape DC 16). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the crocodile can’t bite another target.

attackList.name: Tail
attackList.target: one target not grappled by the crocodile

rider.text: On a hit: If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

attackList.notes: Target: one target not grappled by the crocodile. On a hit: If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

traits.name: Hold Breath
traits.text: The giant crocodile can hold its breath for 30 minutes.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The giant crocodile makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its tail.

tactics: Waits under the waterline, grabs the nearest wader, and drags them under; lets go and sinks away below half HP (42).
loot: No cash. Hide and teeth, 2,500 ES (5 Purple): 1 hour and Survival DC 12 to harvest; on a fail the part is ruined and worth a quarter.
lootSource: DND Bot lock pass S16 (REWARDS §3.2 scale)
description: Bayou-and-estuary giant crocodile that drags waders under.

name: Giant Octopus

attackList.name: Tentacles
attackList.notes: On a hit: If the target is a creature, it is grappled (escape DC 16). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the octopus can’t use its tentacles on another target.

traits.name: Hold Breath
traits.text: While out of water, the giant octopus can hold its breath for 1 hour.

traits.name: Underwater Camouflage
traits.text: The giant octopus has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made while underwater.

traits.name: Water Breathing
traits.text: The giant octopus can breathe only underwater.

actions.name: Ink Cloud
actions.text: A 20-foot-radius cloud of ink extends all around the octopus if it is underwater. The area is heavily obscured for 1 minute, although a significant current can disperse the ink. After releasing the ink, the octopus can use the Dash action as a bonus action.

tactics: Grabs from under the hull or dock and holds one target; inks and jets away below half HP (26).
loot: None worth hauling. A chemist pays 20 ES for the ink sac.
description: Dock-and-reef giant octopus that grabs from below and inks away.

name: Giant Scorpion

attackList.name: Claw
attackList.notes: On a hit: The target is grappled (escape DC 12). The giant scorpion has two claws. While a claw is grappling a creature, the giant scorpion can use only that claw to attack that creature, and that claw can’t attack another target. The target is also restrained until the grapple ends.

attackList.name: Sting
attackList.notes: On a hit: The target must make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw, taking 22 (4d10) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The giant scorpion makes three attacks: two with its claws and one with its sting.

tactics: Pins the nearest target with both claws, then stings it; fights to the death near its burrow.
loot: No cash. Carapace and stinger (alchemists), 2,000 ES: 1 hour and Survival DC 12 to harvest; on a fail the part is ruined and worth a quarter.
description: Wagon-sized desert scorpion with crushing claws and a venom sting.

name: Giant Shark

traits.name: Blood Frenzy
traits.text: The giant shark has advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature that doesn’t have all its hit points.

traits.name: Water Breathing
traits.text: The giant shark can breathe only underwater.

tactics: Circles anything bleeding, then hits the weakest swimmer; breaks off below half HP (63).
loot: No cash. Jaw and teeth, 1,500 ES (3 Purple) to a dockside curio buyer: 1 hour and Survival DC 12 to harvest; on a fail the part is ruined and worth a quarter.
description: Deep-water giant shark that hits boats and takes the swimmers.
pendingJessey: J3: Megalodon duplicate question; S15 loot parity applied

name: Hunter Shark

traits.name: Blood Frenzy
traits.text: The hunter shark has advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature that doesn’t have all its hit points.

traits.name: Water Breathing
traits.text: The hunter shark can breathe only underwater.

tactics: Goes for the bleeding and the lone swimmer; turns away below half HP (22).
loot: No cash. Teeth, 50 ES: 1 hour and Survival DC 12 to harvest; on a fail the part is ruined and worth a quarter.
description: Lone open-water shark that follows blood.

name: Killer Whale

traits.name: Echolocation
traits.text: The killer whale can’t use its blindsight while deafened.

traits.name: Hold Breath
traits.text: The killer whale can hold its breath for 30 minutes.

traits.name: Keen Hearing
traits.text: The killer whale has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing.

tactics: Bites the smallest swimmer or anyone knocked overboard; leaves when the prey gets out of the water.
loot: None. Blubber and bone are a whaler's job, not a party's.
description: Pod-hunting orca that tips swimmers off small boats.

name: The Kraken
languages: understands every tongue spoken on the water but can’t speak; telepathy 120 ft.
damageImmunities: lightning; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
damageImmunitiesNote: Ordinary guns, blades, bullets, and shot are nonmagical. A Story Find weapon, Charged Cartridges, or a gun under Magic Weapon (Rifling) is magical.
nonmagicalNote: Ordinary guns, blades, bullets, and shot are nonmagical. A Story Find weapon, Charged Cartridges, or a gun under Magic Weapon (Rifling) is magical.

attackList.name: Bite
attackList.notes: On a hit: If the target is a Large or smaller creature grappled by the kraken, that creature is swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the creature is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the kraken, and it takes 42 (12d6) acid damage at the start of each of the kraken’s turns. If the kraken takes 50 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the kraken must succeed on a DC 25 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in a space within 10 feet of the kraken. If the kraken dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse using 15 feet of movement, exiting prone.

attackList.name: Tentacle
attackList.notes: On a hit: The target is grappled (escape DC 18). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained. The kraken has ten tentacles, each of which can grapple one target.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.text: The kraken can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Freedom of Movement
traits.text: The kraken ignores difficult terrain, and magical effects can’t reduce its speed or cause it to be restrained. It can spend 5 feet of movement to escape from nonmagical restraints or being grappled.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.text: The kraken deals double damage to objects and structures.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The kraken makes three tentacle attacks, each of which it can replace with one use of Fling.

actions.name: Fling
actions.text: One Large or smaller object held or creature grappled by the kraken is thrown up to 60 feet in a random direction and knocked prone. If a thrown target strikes a solid surface, the target takes 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage for every 10 feet it was thrown. If the target is thrown at another creature, that creature must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or take the same damage and be knocked prone.

actions.name: Lightning Storm
actions.text: The kraken magically creates three bolts of lightning, each of which can strike a target the kraken can see within 120 feet of it. A target must make a DC 23 Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 (4d10) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

legendary.name: Legendary Actions
legendary.text: The kraken can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature’s turn. The kraken regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

legendary.name: Tentacle Attack or Fling
legendary.text: The kraken makes one tentacle attack or uses its Fling.

legendary.name: Ink Cloud (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary.text: While underwater, the kraken expels an ink cloud in a 60-foot radius. The cloud spreads around corners, and that area is heavily obscured to creatures other than the kraken. Each creature other than the kraken that ends its turn there must succeed on a DC 23 Constitution saving throw, taking 16 (3d10) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A strong current disperses the cloud, which otherwise disappears at the end of the kraken’s next turn.

tactics: Tentacles pull sailors off the deck while it flings the rest and storms the rigging; it never retreats in its own water.
loot: Nothing on the body. The prize is the open sea route (story).
description: The sea beast that blocks the sail-around: tentacles, lightning, and ink.

traits.name: Water Breathing

tactics: Hits the boat first, then takes whoever goes over the side; never leaves blood in the water.

name: Mesa Rattler

attackList.notes: On a hit: The target is grappled (escape DC 16). Until this grapple ends, the creature is restrained, and the mesa rattler can’t constrict another target.

tactics: Strikes from rimrock or brush, wraps one target, and squeezes; slithers off below half HP (30).
loot: No cash. Hide and rattle, 1,500 ES: 1 hour and Survival DC 12 to harvest; on a fail the part is ruined and worth a quarter.
lootSource: drop table §1.8 (DND Bot lock pass S17)

name: Prairie Coyote

traits.text: The prairie coyote has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.text: The prairie coyote has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the coyote’s allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn’t incapacitated.

tactics: Nips at stragglers and horses; the pack scatters as soon as one coyote drops or fire comes out.
loot: No cash. Pelt (30 ES) or county varmint bounty on the ears (50 ES): 1 hour and Survival DC 12 to harvest; on a fail the part is ruined and worth a quarter.

name: Prairie Griffon

traits.name: Keen Sight
traits.text: The prairie griffon has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The prairie griffon makes two attacks: one with its beak and one with its claws.

tactics: Dives on horses and mounts first; flees at half HP (29).
tacticsSource: IDEAS side encounters (flee at half); horses-first is DRAFT
loot: No cash. Feathers or trophy, 2,500 ES (a live egg is a story beat, not a drop): 1 hour and Survival DC 12 to harvest; on a fail the part is ruined and worth a quarter.

name: Rattlesnake

attackList.name: Bite
attackList.notes: On a hit: The target must make a DC 10 Constitution saving throw, taking 5 (2d4) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

tactics: Bites only when stepped on or cornered, then slithers away.
loot: No cash. Rattle or venom gland, 50 ES: 1 hour and Survival DC 12 to harvest; on a fail the part is ruined and worth a quarter.
description: Desert rattlesnake that bites when stepped on.

name: Reef Shark

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.text: The reef shark has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the reef shark’s allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn’t incapacitated.

traits.name: Water Breathing
traits.text: The reef shark can breathe only underwater.

tactics: Hunts with the school for Pack Tactics; the school scatters when one shark dies.
loot: No cash. Teeth, 25 ES: 1 hour and Survival DC 12 to harvest; on a fail the part is ruined and worth a quarter.
description: Small reef shark that hunts in schools.

name: Restless Pioneer
languages: understands the languages it knew in life but can’t speak
damageResistances: acid, cold, fire, lightning, thunder; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
damageResistancesNote: Ordinary guns, blades, bullets, and shot are nonmagical. A Story Find weapon, Charged Cartridges, or a gun under Magic Weapon (Rifling) is magical. Primal Strike and other “counts as magical” features overcome the resistance.
conditionImmunities: charmed, exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, unconscious
nonmagicalNote: Ordinary guns, blades, bullets, and shot are nonmagical. A Story Find weapon, Charged Cartridges, or a gun under Magic Weapon (Rifling) is magical. Primal Strike and other “counts as magical” features overcome the resistance.

attackList.name: Life Drain
attackList.notes: On a hit: The target must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or its hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. This reduction lasts until the creature finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.text: The restless pioneer can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.text: While in sunlight, the restless pioneer has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

tactics: Hunts whoever carries the curse; ghosts don't run.
loot: Grave goods only, d6: 1-3 nothing; 4 a tintype or letter (a name, a claim, a hook); 5 one Yellow in a buried watch pocket (100 ES); 6 a Dirty Dulls Rolling-Block Rifle and 6 .44-40 rounds (gear, not cash).
description: Pioneer ghost bound to a cursed claim or grave.

name: Riding Horse
tactics: Bolts from gunfire unless a rider calms it; kicks only when cornered.
loot: Not harvested. A caught horse can be kept or sold, but a brand means heat.
description: Ordinary trail stock: bay, roan, paint, or scrub mustang.

name: Sandie
languages: understands Common and the tribal tongue it knew in life; speaks only in broken whispers, howls, and stolen scraps of words

traits.name: Undead Fortitude
traits.text: If damage reduces the Sandie to 0 hit points, it must make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5 + the damage taken, unless the damage is radiant or from a critical hit. On a success, the Sandie drops to 1 hit point instead.

traits.name: Eldorite Hunger
traits.text: The Sandie has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks to notice Eldorite, Eldorite glow, or creatures carrying visible Eldorite within 60 feet.

tactics: Goes for whoever shows the most Eldorite and never runs; a thrown shard distracts it.
loot: Gut pouch, d8: 1-4 1d4 Black (0 ES); 5-6 1d4 Black + 1d4 White (about 2 ES); 7 one Blue + Black (10 ES); 8 a half-eaten Green (50 ES), or on a d4 roll of 4 a live Yellow (100 ES). Average about 10 ES. No guns or gear.
description: Eldorite-hollowed zombie with a spark of hunger left; goes for shards.

name: Scorpion

attackList.name: Sting
attackList.notes: On a hit: The target must make a DC 9 Constitution saving throw, taking 4 (1d8) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

tactics: Stings whatever disturbs it, then hides.
loot: No cash. Venom gland, 50 ES: 1 hour and Survival DC 12 to harvest; on a fail the part is ruined and worth a quarter.
description: Thumb-to-palm desert scorpion that hides in boots and bedrolls.

name: Thunder Eagle
senses: blindsight 30 ft., darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 19

attackList.name: Bite
attackList.notes: Plus 1d10 lightning damage on a hit (add it by hand).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The thunder eagle makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

actions.name: Lightning Breath
actions.text: The thunder eagle exhales lightning in a 60-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw, taking 55 (10d10) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

tactics: Breathes lightning on the biggest group from the air, then dives on the loudest; leaves at a quarter HP (38).
loot: Nothing to harvest.
description: Storm-scaled mesa dragon wearing eagle myth; breathes lightning.

name: Warhorse

traits.name: Trampling Charge
traits.text: If the warhorse moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a hooves attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the warhorse can make another attack with its hooves against it as a bonus action.

tactics: Trampling Charge at whatever its rider points it at; riderless, it bolts unless cornered.
loot: Not harvested. A caught horse can be kept or sold, but a brand means heat.
description: Heavy combat charger used to powder and shouting.

name: Common Townsfolk

attackList.name: Baton
attackList.notes: Simple. Light. Baton or belaying pin.

tactics: Scatters or surrenders when guns come out; fights only for home or kin.
loot: Pocket change, about 15 ES (a White or a Blue and a few Whites). Robbing townsfolk draws the law.
description: Settlers, clerks, and porch folk with whatever's to hand.

name: Company Rider
attacks: Trail Mace +4 (1d6+2 bludgeoning), Lancaster Rifle +2 (1d10 piercing, 30/120, 6 rds, MF 1)

attackList.name: Trail Mace
